clusters.name: Teodor's death, 1978–1979
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Teodor's death in January 1978, within the year: your grandmother Delphine stopped cooking and went to her mother every evening; your father took night shifts and distanced from your mother; your uncle Anton drank at lunch with a warning at work and then separated from Celeste; your mother's anxiety rose over Anton; and your brother Callum had ear infections through the winter. These shifts pile up in the months after the death, each one's troubles near another's, and settle by May 1979 when your grandmother took a job at the library.

clusters.name: Odette's bed rest, 1984
clusters.reason: Around your mother's bed rest in March 1984: your grandmother Hazel came every morning to keep house and then argued with your father over how she kept it; your brother Callum stammered again after a year free of it. These shifts cluster in the same months as your mother's drop in functioning, and settle within weeks as the household adjusted to the new arrangement.

clusters.name: Hazel's Parkinson's diagnosis, 1986–1996
clusters.reason: Around your grandmother Hazel's diagnosis in September 1986, over the following decade: your grandfather Ambrose took over her cooking and appointments; your father's anxiety rose as he phoned his father every night; Hazel had a bad fall and then steadied on new medicine; your father and uncle Lyle argued over who should help their parents; your grandfather had chest pains; and your father drank most evenings. Shifts pile up in the years after the diagnosis, each one's troubles near another's, and settle in late 1997 after Hazel moved to the nursing home and your father cut his drinking back.

clusters.name: Callum leaving home, 1999–2000
clusters.reason: Around your brother Callum leaving home for work up north in May 1999: your father and he argued most nights over his plans; your mother could not settle and her anxiety rose; your father missed days at work and sat late in the garage; your sister Ines skipped school most of that autumn; your mother then took Ines with her everywhere. These shifts cluster around the same time as Callum's departure, each one's troubles near another's, and settle by August 2000 when Ines was back at school full days and had passed her exams.
